source.title: Identity-Specific Reward Representations in Orbitofrontal Cortex Are Modulated by Selective Devaluation

confidence_rationale: Best available match to 'separately-learnable': human MVPA shows OFC carries outcome-identity-specific, independently-updatable representations dissociable from general scalar value (vmPFC). But it is correlational fMRI and the finer channel still routes through a vmPFC value bottleneck to influence choice.
failure_signatures: The OFC identity channel had to route through vmPFC general-value coding to influence choice (connectivity-predicted choice change), mildly supporting a funnel into a common value bottleneck -- the conversion-ceiling architecture MECH-451 worries about.
Correlational fMRI: connectivity PREDICTS choice change, it does not show that exposing a finer channel CAUSES better conversion of control influence into committed action.

mapping.source_claim_statement: After selective sensory-specific satiety, OFC reward-IDENTITY patterns were selectively altered only for the devalued outcome (retained for the non-sated one), and OFC<->vmPFC connectivity predicted individual choice change -- i.e. OFC holds outcome-specific, separately-updatable representations distinct from a general value scalar.
mapping.ree_translation: Closest biological cousin to MECH-451's 'OFC-devaluation' finer channel: a representation finer than a compressed scalar, independently updatable by state, dissociable from general value coding.
mapping.mapping_caveat: 'Separately-updatable representation' is a close cousin of 'separately-learnable channel' but not identical; correlational fMRI cannot show a GATING LEARNER benefits, and the channel funnels through a shared value node.
mapping.source_context: Human fMRI with MVPA during selective devaluation of one of two value-matched food odours.

confidence_components.notes: Strongest mapping_fidelity in the set for the separately-learnable angle, but still correlational and bottleneck-funnelled.
